CI 33968911148 and release dry-run 33968911165 passed on this exact commit; the twelve release gates passed on the byte-identical a0d64245 tree. The README and releases.md correction resolves ratified db87db21 as found at a0d64245: the packaged README installs jsonataddl/v0.2.0, states the v0.1.2 input-contract and MaxInputDepth migration and identity re-pin, and delegates release ordering to releases.md, which owns the v0.2.0 preflight, expected-checksum comparison and the separate root-requirement follow-up. Source approval versus publication: this verdict approves the source tree for sealing under child 8eb99e73 (promise f4679b6b). It is also the gate-2 permission to publish jsonataddl/v0.2.0 at this same exact commit only once that commit is incorporated through a sealed merge into public main; publication remains the work of parent b9d6cd89 (promise 9f5158a0): repeat the absence preflight immediately before pushing only this exact annotated nested tag (the proxy list, sumdb and origin still show no v0.2.0), require actual tag CI and a fresh-cache external-consumer resolution matching both h1 values, and record the final release evidence. Ordinary staleness of the request bases is acknowledged as the request states; no design replacement. Inventory activation, the root requirement bump and I7 remain separate. Architecture: core and host contracts preserved; documentation-only tree, no layer added. Security: public absence confirmed, tuple immutable and reproduced from the reviewed bytes, expected-versus-public checksum equality is an explicit documented gate, preflight fails closed, zip is an exact image with no vendor, symlinks, build tags or generated files. Simplification: one detailed release procedure in releases.md and a version-neutral README apart from its own install line.
